content.value: Consider the generator matrix G for an $( m , k , d , N _ { d } )$ linear block code given bellow:
(i) Specify the values of code parameters m, k, d and $N _ { d } .$
(ii) Assunie that the uncoded binary pulse amplitude modulation (PAM) system has the error probability;
$\mathcal { Q } \bigg ( \sqrt { \frac { 2 E _ { b } } { N _ { 0 } } } \bigg )$ , where $E _ { b }$ is the energy per bit and $N _ { \theta } / 2$ is the noise power spectrał
denșity (PSD). Find the union bound estimate for the error probability per bit $P _ { \ b }$ in term of $E _ { b } / N _ { \theta }$ for the above code.
(iii) Compute the coding gain (numerically in dB) for this block code at ${ \cal P } _ { b } { = } 1 0 ^ { - 4 }$
NOTE: for numerical computation, you may find some of the following useful equations:

$$
\mathcal { Q } \left( \sqrt { \frac { 2 E _ { b } } { N _ { 0 } } } \right) = 1 0 ^ { - 4 } \Rightarrow \frac { E _ { b } } { N _ { 0 } } \cong 8 . 4 d B
$$

$$
\frac { 4 } { 3 } Q \left( \sqrt { \frac { 3 E _ { h } } { N _ { 0 } } } \right) = 1 0 ^ { - 4 } \Rightarrow \frac { E _ { h } } { N _ { 0 } } \cong 6 . 8 d B
$$

$$
\frac { 4 } { 3 } \mathcal { Q } \left( \sqrt { \frac { 4 E _ { b } } { N _ { 0 } } } \right) = 1 0 ^ { - 4 } \Rightarrow \frac { E _ { b } } { N _ { 0 } } \cong 5 . 6 d B
$$

$$
{ \mathit { \zeta } } _ { 3 } ^ { \prime } { \mathit { Q } } { \left( { \sqrt { \frac { 4 E _ { b } } { N _ { 0 } } } } \right) } { = } 1 0 ^ { - 4 } \Rightarrow { \frac { E _ { h } } { N _ { 0 } } } \cong 5 . 9 d B
$$
